privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: How ETHPL collects, uses and protects the information you share with us.
privacy.status_note: This page is a placeholder pending legal review. It is published because corporate and school buyers check for it before sharing staff or student data, but it is not yet a complete policy.

sections.heading: What we collect
sections.body: When you request a proposal we collect the name of your organisation, a contact name, a work email or phone number, and the details of the event you describe - destination, approximate dates, group size and any notes you add. We do not ask for payment details on this website.

sections.heading: Why we collect it
sections.body: We use it only to prepare and discuss your proposal and to contact you about that enquiry. We do not sell your information. We do not add you to a marketing list without your consent.

sections.heading: TODO(ethpl): sections still required before legal sign-off
sections.body: A lawyer should add: how long data is retained; which third parties receive it (hotels, airlines, visa processors, your booking partner); international transfer handling; your rights under India's Digital Personal Data Protection Act including how to request deletion; cookie and analytics disclosure; the name and email of a grievance officer; and the date the policy takes effect.

terms.title: Terms & Conditions
terms.intro: The terms that apply to using this website and requesting a proposal from ETHPL.
terms.status_note: This page is a placeholder pending legal review. Proposal-specific commercial terms are issued with each written proposal and take precedence over anything on this page.

sections.heading: This website is an information catalogue
sections.body: Destinations, itineraries and any figures shown here are indicative and for planning only. They are not an offer and not a confirmed quotation. Pricing and availability are confirmed only in a written proposal issued by ETHPL for your specific event and dates.

sections.heading: Requesting a proposal
sections.body: Submitting the enquiry form creates no contract and no obligation on either side. A booking exists only once a written proposal is accepted and the stated confirmation terms are met.
